values.note: Sites 3-8 book online through My County Parks up to a year ahead and no later than 4 days before arrival; reservations are non-refundable, with one reschedule for $15 by calling the conservation office. note: Dubuque County Conservation 116-acre rec area NE of Cascade on Hwy 151, around the Fillmore Fairways nine-hole golf course; showers are in the clubhouse. Water and the shower/restroom building close approximately November 1 - May 1. Whitewater Creek, about 12 m wide, runs west of the far loop (sites 9-12) behind bank trees. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $30, partial online booking + FCFS; added 30-amp + water at the site, 12 sites (3-8 reservable, 33-48 ft back-ins), clubhouse showers/flush toilets, dump, potable water, 1-year window, 4-day cutoff, 14-night limit. Not waterfront stands (creek ~12 m wide, trees between). Note trimmed and the 'pull-in pads' corrected (they are back-ins).
flags: PHONE (lead): the stored 563-556-6745 is the Dubuque County Conservation office, the number the booking terms give for rescheduling. The park page's own contact is 'PRO SHOP: (563) 852-3377' (the clubhouse, which also takes pavilion bookings). Either works; the office is the one for campsites.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. On NAIP, Whitewater Creek is ~10-14 m wide (creek, under the ~30 m line) and runs 17-28 m west of the far loop (9-12) with bank trees between; sites 1-8 sit on a spur road above a wooded gully. No change.
PIN: the stored 42.32409,-90.91120 is at the east end of the camp road beside sites 1-2, ~70 m from the middle of the row. Fine.

SEASON: no campground season is posted (the park page's season is the golf course's, 'Typically, the season open in April and closes November'); only the water/shower closure (about Nov 1 - May 1) is stated, so season was left unset.
